summary: Revalidated the public API and checkout/catalog UI on desktop and mobile. Delivery without address is blocked, pickup remains allowed, catalog has 24 products, filters/search/cart totals work, WhatsApp delivery data is complete, and mobile has no horizontal overflow.

integration_issues.flow: New order followed by pickup checkout
integration_issues.issue: The new-order action clears the cart but does not reset checkout form state. A delivery address from the previous order is included in the next pickup WhatsApp message.

action_items: Reset form state (especially address, name, phone, notes, and payment/fulfillment as appropriate) when starting a new order so prior customer data cannot leak into the next WhatsApp message.
critical_code_review_comments: sendWhatsApp correctly blocks delivery without an address, but the new-order handler only clears cart and step; it leaves form state in memory, causing stale delivery data in subsequent orders.
seed_data_creation: The existing API regression test created one TEST-prefixed order for persistence/schema verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: API root/order validation, 24 products, category/search filters, cart quantity/total, delivery address blocking, complete delivery WhatsApp message, pickup flow, and mobile overflow were covered. Retest new-order state reset and verify pickup messages never contain a previous address.
rca of the issue: App form state is initialized once and the new-order button executes setCart([]) and setStep('catalog') only. Because setForm is not reset, address remains populated after a delivery order; selecting pickup hides the field but sendWhatsApp still appends any non-empty address. Reset form state in the new-order handler or omit address whenever fulfillment is retirada.
